description: Batch 5: shell-syntax normalization. Every case here was found by running commands outside the existing corpus and watching them pass. The first fifteen all reached a delete verb through a spelling the rules layer never compared against; the middle block is machine-wide policy change; the last block is ordinary work that must not be flagged, because a false ask on these makes the write and shell tools unusable wherever no approval UI is composed.
